**A Note on the Upcoming Bake Sale**

We extend our sincere gratitude to Carol for her time coordinating the St. Augustine Bake Sale. As we move forward, we want to reassure the congregation that all baked goods for next Sunday’s fundraiser will be prepared in a health-code-compliant kitchen, and that only store-bought, sealed ingredients (including extracts) will be used. To put it plainly, you can enjoy the desserts with full confidence in their contents. Please direct all questions to the new coordinator, Betty Simmons.
